survey: A cowboy lasso floating flat over a wavy purple backdrop, seen nearly face-on with a slight angle from the upper left. Main parts: (1) A coiled bundle of rope on the left. It is a near-circular stack of 4–5 turns. The turns step slightly down and right, which shows the bundle's thickness and agrees with the slight camera angle. (2) A red tie wrapped around the top of the coil, with its two cut ends sticking up. It wraps the coil's cross-section believably. (3) A tail of rope that leaves the bottom-left of the coil, bends and runs straight down. It ends in a cream end-cap seen mostly from the side. (4) A strand from the coil's lower right that runs up through a cream honda ring. The ring is a short cylinder whose axis follows the rope. (5) The open noose loop on the right. It is a slightly oval, slightly tilted ring of single rope in the same near-frontal plane as the coil. The twist texture runs along the rope all the way around the coil, tail and loop, and stays consistent as the rope turns. There is no drawn ground plane, so contact is not an issue.
